title: Brownout
text: Not enough power for everything. The cryo bank is drawing down its buffer. Something has to go dark tonight.

choices.label: Dim the homes
choices.reply: Homes on minimum heat. People sleep in their coats. They know whose call it was.

choices.label: Slow the mines
choices.reply: Depots throttled back. The embryos stay cold and safe; the alloy count stalls.

choices.label: Put it to the colony
choices.reply: The question goes out on every screen. The vote is tonight.
